answer: Make every new agent identity lock a slashable bond for 45 days before its attestations count. The kernel of the idea is cost: a farm of 500 fakes must freeze 500 bonds, and if graders find the accounts were funded from one wallet, all of them get slashed together. Like shale splitting along one seam, a shared funding trail cracks the whole cluster, so the attacker faces a canyon of loss instead of cheap votes.
